{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for imbalance
ct = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print(ct)

# Compute revenue per channel, stratified by customer_segment
revenue_by_channel_segment = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Show the stratified revenue
revenue_by_channel_segment"}
